Self.Wiki: This map object represents a platoon setup for an ensemble.

PlatoonScriptId.Wiki: The platoon script to use for this ensemble

State.Wiki: The platoon's starting reflect state, which AI scripts change later. 0 or 1 in the game files.

EnableDeactiveMove.Wiki: The starting value of the platoon's enable-deactive-move flag, which AI scripts change later.

UseMemberEntityIDs.Wiki: If ON, the characters in Member Entity ID also join the platoon.

MemberEntityIDs.Wiki: Characters that join the platoon when Use Member Entity IDs is ON. 10000 is the player. 0 for none.

GroupPartsNames.Wiki: A character that belongs to this platoon.
